title: Efficient Graph Partitioning under Resource Constraints: A Cutting-Plane Framework for Distribution Grids
summary: This paper presents an optimal network topology control framework using cutting-plane methods for efficient network partitioning with controllable edges. The objective is to enable real-time reconfiguration of interconnected subnetworks while ensuring radial connectivity, resource feasibility, and structured leader allocation, which provide structural foundations for distributed controllability, stability, and coordination.
